title: Camp Guide - Expedition 33 Camping System & Features
description: Complete camping guide for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Learn how to camp, upgrade weapons, build relationships, allocate Lumina Points, and use the Curator.

sections.title: Camping Overview
sections.content:
Camping is Expedition 33's hub system where you upgrade gear, build character relationships, and prepare for the next phase of your journey. Press D-Down on the world map to set up camp at any time outside of combat.

What You Can Do at Camp

  • Talk to party members (build relationships)
  • Upgrade weapons and consumables at the Curator
  • Allocate Lumina Points
  • Change party formation
  • Review collected Pictos
  • Access side activities

sections.title: The Curator — Weapon & Item Upgrades
sections.content:
The Curator is your upgrade specialist at camp. They handle:

Weapon Upgrades

ServiceCostEffect
Weapon Rank UpChroma CatalystsIncrease weapon rank (D → C → B → A → S)
Consumable UpgradeMaterialsImprove healing item effectiveness

Tips

  • Prioritize upgrading your main DPS character's weapon first
  • Chroma Catalysts are found in chests, Paint Cages, and as boss drops
  • Higher rank weapons gain improved scaling and sometimes new move properties
  • You can upgrade any party member's weapon regardless of who's in your active party

sections.title: Relationship System
sections.content:
Speaking with party members at camp increases your relationship level with them. This is one of the most important camp activities.

Relationship Levels

LevelUnlock
Level 1Basic conversations, learn backstory
Level 2Personal side quests become available
Level 3Unique Gradient Attack unlocked

How to Build Relationships

  • Talk to each party member at camp after major story events
  • New dialogue options appear after bosses, chapter transitions, and side quests
  • Some responses give more relationship points than others
  • Include the character in your active party for bonus relationship events

Important: Reaching Level 3 with a character unlocks their unique Gradient Attack — these are among the strongest abilities in the game. Prioritize your main party members.

sections.title: Lumina Point Allocation
sections.content:
Lumina Points are earned on level-up and allow you to equip unlocked Pictos effects to any character.

How Lumina Works

  1. Equip a Pictos and win 4 battles with it equipped
  2. The Pictos' Lumina effect permanently unlocks
  3. At camp, spend Lumina Points to assign that effect to any character
  4. Characters can stack multiple Lumina effects

Tips

  • Don't forget to allocate! Many players earn Lumina Points and never spend them.
  • Stack complementary effects (e.g., AP generation + crit damage)
  • Spread utility effects (healing, defense) across your whole party
  • The Lumina menu is in the Camp pause menu — check it every few levels

sections.title: When to Camp vs. Rest at Flags
sections.content:
Camp (D-Down)

  • Does NOT respawn enemies
  • Full access to Curator, relationships, Lumina
  • Available anywhere on the world map
  • Does NOT heal your party

Expedition Flags (Rest Points)

  • Heals your party fully
  • Respawns all enemies in the area
  • Limited to specific locations
  • Good for farming XP, bad if you just want to heal

Chroma Elixirs (Best of Both)

  • Fully heals party without respawning enemies
  • Replenished at every rest point
  • Use these freely — they're designed to be consumed often

Pro tip: Use Chroma Elixirs for healing, Camp for upgrades/relationships, and Expedition Flags only when you want enemies back (for farming).
